description: This file implements the MonitorJsonRpc class, providing JSON-RPC API endpoints for managing plugin restart limits, resetting plugin statistics, retrieving plugin status, and signaling actions within a monitoring system. It includes registration and unregistration of API methods, and defines methods for handling restart limits, resetting stats, getting status, and emitting action events.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: A class providing JSON-RPC API endpoints for plugin monitoring, including restart limits, stats reset, status retrieval, and action signaling.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC methods and properties for the Monitor class.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all JSON-RPC methods and properties for the Monitor class.

methods.name: endpoint_restartlimits
methods.description: Sets new restart limits for a specified plugin based on provided parameters.

methods.name: endpoint_resetstats
methods.description: Resets memory and process statistics for a specified plugin and returns its current info.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves memory and process statistics for a plugin or all plugins.

methods.name: event_action
methods.description: Signals an action taken by the monitor for a specific plugin.
